name: io.github.rushirb2001/cohors
title: cohors
description: Every git repo on your machine for your agent: status, cross-repo search, tasks, opt-in git actions

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: A folder that holds your git repositories; repeat it for several. Leave it out to use the roots in your cohors config, or the folders cohors detects.

environmentVariables.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A GitHub token for CI and pull-request status. Not needed when the GitHub CLI (gh) is signed in.
